name: Quadratics
description: Factorise, solve and sketch quadratics, then find the price that maximises revenue.

lessonNames.l2-product-and-sum: Two numbers from a product and a sum
lessonNames.l3-leading-coefficient: When the square term has a coefficient
lessonNames.l5-product-of-zero: Why a product of zero helps
lessonNames.l11-meeting-the-axis: Where the curve meets the axis

lessonObjectives.l1-two-brackets: Expand $(x + a)(x + b)$ with an area model and spot where each term comes from.
lessonObjectives.l2-product-and-sum: Factorise $x^2 + bx + c$ by finding the pair with the right product and sum.
lessonObjectives.l3-leading-coefficient: Factorise $ax^2 + bx + c$ by splitting the middle term.
lessonObjectives.l4-difference-of-squares: Recognise and factorise $a^2 - b^2$ on sight.
lessonObjectives.l5-product-of-zero: Solve a factorised quadratic by setting each bracket to zero.
lessonObjectives.l6-completing-the-square: Rewrite a quadratic as a square plus a constant using a square diagram.
lessonObjectives.l7-the-formula: Derive the quadratic formula by completing the square, then use it.
lessonObjectives.l8-how-many-solutions: Use the discriminant to count real roots before solving.
lessonObjectives.l9-shape-of-a-square: Sketch $y = x^2$ and its relatives and read their line of symmetry.
lessonObjectives.l10-turning-point: Read the vertex of a parabola from its completed square form.
lessonObjectives.l11-meeting-the-axis: Connect roots, intercepts and the discriminant on a sketch.
lessonObjectives.l12-above-or-below: Solve a quadratic inequality from a sketch of the parabola.
lessonObjectives.l13-best-price: Model revenue as a quadratic in price and find the price that maximises it.
